actions.description: hold the up arrow: Pac-Man goes up at the next tile where up is open
hold the down arrow: Pac-Man goes down at the next tile where down is open
hold the left arrow: Pac-Man goes left (the tunnel row wraps around)
hold the right arrow: Pac-Man goes right (the tunnel row wraps around)

notes: heading is Pac-Man's current motion: N=up, S=down, W=left, E=right, stop. Each block up/down/left/right describes holding that arrow from Pac-Man's next turning tile. open: 1 = a corridor goes that way. room: maze tiles Pac-Man can reach that way at least one step before any coloured ghost (max 30); under 8 means a trap. food: steps to the nearest pellet that way over those tiles; 60 or more means the pellet can only be reached past a ghost; 99 means none. power: steps to a big power pellet that way. prey: steps to the nearest blue (edible) ghost that way. ghost: steps from that tile to the nearest dangerous ghost. nearGhost: steps from the nearest dangerous ghost to Pac-Man. blue: number of blue ghosts. flashing=1: they are about to turn dangerous again. Rules (only ever pick an action with open=1): 1) If an action has room>=3 and prey<=10 (prey<=4 when flashing=1), pick the one with the smallest prey. 2) Otherwise, look only at actions with room>=8. If blue=0 and nearGhost<=6 and one of them has power<=6, pick the smallest power. Otherwise pick the smallest food, but keep the heading's action when its food is within 0.5 of the smallest. 3) If no action has room>=8, pick the largest room (on a tie, the largest ghost). When visible=0 or over=true, nothing matters.
